text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The one who conquered the Satsuki Sho was 
Tokai Teio. Having claimed the first 
crown, she bathed in applause. Meanwhile, 
Twin Turbo—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shocked by the gap in ability between 
herself and the Umamusume she considers 
her rival... she resolves to train harder 
and win next time.
